value.rationale: The three-color exact-composition word class is natural and tightly constrained, yet static capacity 2m permits adaptive 3m query levels for all m. This produces an infinite linear VC–Littlestone separation, not a stand-alone small-case enumeration, and the precise seed tree is useful as a modular construction. No equality at larger m is overstated.
